title: Feast of Crows
text: A field of crows, thousands of them, all facing the same way. They are silent, every one, and all of them are eating something you cannot see. Now and then a head lifts and turns toward you, beak wet, and then goes back to feeding.

options.label: Run at them shouting and scatter them, before you learn what they are eating.

outcomes.text: They rise like smoke, thousands of wings at once. Afterward the air feels lighter, as if something has been driven off.
They rise like smoke, wheel once, then come down on you beak-first for interrupting their meal.

options.label: The wisest reads the omens in their rows, hoping to learn what the crows already know.

outcomes.text: The pattern is a warning written in black wings. The wisest commits every line of it to memory.
The crows shift until they form a face, the wisest's own, which slowly opens its mouth to speak.
